question:
Choose the correct one-word substitute for:

A system of governance controlled by the wealthy
solution:
The correct answer is: **Plutocracy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Plutocracy"** refers to a system of governance where the wealthy class controls the decision-making process and political power. (धनिक शासन)

 
 
• **Example:** Some critics argue that modern democracies are becoming plutocracies due to the influence of wealthy corporations on politics.
 
 
 
• The correct word highlights the idea of governance or rule by the affluent, emphasizing wealth as the key determinant of power and influence. (धनिक वर्ग द्वारा शासन)

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Plutocracy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Oligarchy** (अल्पतंत्र): A system of governance where a small group of people, often distinguished by their wealth, family ties, or military control, hold power.

 
 
• **Example:** The country was ruled by an oligarchy that consisted of the most influential families.
 
 
 
• **Aristocracy** (कुलीनतंत्र): A form of governance led by the nobility or a privileged class, who are seen as superior in terms of lineage, education, or culture.
 
 
• **Example:** In history, many European countries were governed by an aristocracy that controlled most of the land and wealth.
 
 
 
• **Meritocracy** (योग्यता शासन): A system of governance where individuals are chosen and promoted based on their abilities, talents, and performance, rather than wealth or class.
 
 
• **Example:** The company prides itself on being a meritocracy where promotions are based solely on performance.
